violation_type.title: Storage of Medication - Not Contaminate Food (26 TAC §744.2657(2))
violation_type.short_title: Storage of Medication - Not Contaminate Food
violation_type.typical_finding: At the time of inspection prescribed medication was observed to be stored in two of the operation's first aid kits which were not locked and were within the reach of children.
